title: TripPlanner — alerts, requests, plans, models, tools
description: Phases 29, 30 and 34. Read from GET /metrics of the backend by Prometheus; the log lines from Loki; what fires, from the rules in docker/observability/alerts/.

panels.title: Alerts — what is firing now, from docker/observability/alerts/rules.yml (Phase 34); what to do: docs/runbook.md
Alerts firing
panels.description: How many alerts Prometheus says are firing for these backends. Each has been sent to Alertmanager, and from there on (http://localhost:9093).

panels.title: Alerts, firing and pending
panels.description: Every alert that holds now: pending is its condition true and its `for:` not yet over; firing has been sent. Empty is nothing wrong. The message, the runbook link and what was sent: Prometheus /alerts, the alert receiver /alerts.

panels.title: Plans, p99 (10 min)
panels.description: The slowest plans: p99 of the runs POST /trips/{id}/plan started, over the last 10 minutes — what PlanLatencyHigh watches. Red from 30 s, its threshold.

panels.title: Model calls failing
panels.description: Calls to a model that failed, a minute, over the last 5 minutes — what ModelErrorRateHigh watches. Red over 10, its threshold.

panels.title: Model cost, an hour
panels.description: What the models were asked cost at list price, at the rate of the last hour (llm_cost_usd_total; src/ai/usage.py has the prices). On a free tier nothing is charged.

panels.title: Embeddings owed
panels.description: Itineraries waiting for their embedding (embedding_queue_depth): being embedded now, plus those that failed and are retried at the next start. The whole system's number — every backend reports the same.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests a second over the last five minutes — without health checks.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: The share of requests answered 5xx over the last five minutes.

panels.title: Duration, p95
panels.description: 95 of 100 requests were answered — to the first byte — within this, over the last five minutes.

panels.title: Plans being made
panels.description: Planning runs in progress right now.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio
panels.description: mcp_cache_hit_ratio: of the tool server's cache lookups in the last five minutes, the share that were hits.

panels.title: Model calls
panels.description: Calls to a language model per minute, over the last five minutes.

panels.title: Requests — rate, errors, duration per endpoint
Request rate
panels.description: Requests a second, by endpoint as the router names it.

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Of each endpoint's requests, the share answered 5xx. The dashed line is EndpointErrorRateHigh's threshold, 5%.

targets.expr: (sum by (handler) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job", handler!~"/ready|/ping|/version|none", status="5xx"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (handler) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job", handler!~"/ready|/ping|/version|none"}[$__rate_interval])) * 0) / sum by (handler) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job", handler!~"/ready|/ping|/version|none"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Duration, p95
panels.description: Time to the first byte, by endpoint. An event stream is counted until it opens, not until it closes.

panels.title: Every endpoint, over the last five minutes
panels.description: One row per endpoint: how often it is asked, how often it fails, how long it takes.

targets.expr: ((sum by (handler) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job", status="5xx"}[5m])) or sum by (handler) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[5m])) * 0) / sum by (handler) (rate(http_requests_total{job=~"$job"}[5m]))) >= 0

panels.title: Planning — the runs behind POST /trips/{id}/plan, which is itself answered at once
Planning runs
panels.description: Runs that ended, by how: completed (a plan was saved), no_plan (nothing found, or a question back to the traveller), crashed, interrupted (the server stopped).

panels.title: How long a plan takes
panels.description: A whole run, from the request that started it to the row that ended it. From a histogram: each value is placed within its bucket, 2.5 s wide where plans usually land. The p99 is PlanLatencyHigh's own measure: the plans POST /plan started, over 10 minutes; the dashed line is its threshold, 30 s.

panels.title: Itinerary builds
panels.description: itinerary_builds_total: saved (success), sent back by the evaluator to be built again (retry), given up (failure).

panels.title: Embedding queue
panels.description: Itineraries waiting for their embedding (embedding_queue_depth, counted every 15 s): in_flight is being embedded now; pending_retry failed and is retried at the next start (Phase 14). Each backend reports the whole system's numbers, so the highest is shown.

panels.title: Models — llm_calls_total, by the agent that asked
Model calls by agent
panels.description: Calls a minute, by the agent whose work they were part of.

panels.title: Model calls by model
panels.description: Calls a minute by model, and the ones that failed. The dashed line is ModelErrorRateHigh's threshold: 10 failed calls a minute.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Tokens a minute: sent to the models (input) and written by them (output).

panels.title: Model cost
panels.description: What the models were asked cost at list price, in US dollars an hour, by model (llm_cost_usd_total). A model with no price on record is not in it — GET /admin/cost-summary counts its tokens as unpriced.

panels.title: Tool server — calls, and what its cache did for them
Tool calls
panels.description: Calls a minute to the tool server, by tool, and the ones that came back as an error.

panels.title: Tool call duration, p95
panels.description: How long a call took, by tool. A cached answer is milliseconds; a provider's is seconds.

panels.title: Cache hits by cache
panels.description: Of each cache's lookups over five minutes, the share that were hits. Warming a trip's caches is a miss each; planning it is then a hit each. The dashed line is CacheHitRatioLow's threshold, 30% (of the gauge, which counts every cache together).

targets.expr: (sum by (cache) (rate(mcp_cache_lookups_total{job=~"$job", result="hit"}[5m])) or sum by (cache) (rate(mcp_cache_lookups_total{job=~"$job"}[5m])) * 0) / sum by (cache) (rate(mcp_cache_lookups_total{job=~"$job"}[5m]))

panels.title: Under load — what this process runs out of first (Phase 30)
Database connections
panels.description: The pool's connections: lent to a request or a planning run (in use), kept for the next (idle), and the most it will open (limit). In use at the limit means requests are waiting for a connection.

panels.title: Redis connections and open streams
panels.description: Every open event stream keeps one Redis connection for as long as the page is open. The limit is not a queue: a command over it fails at once.

panels.title: Event loop lateness
panels.description: How late the event loop ran what was due. One loop serves every request of the process: while something holds it — a password being hashed — every other request waits this long, whatever its own timing says.

panels.title: Log lines — every service's, for one trip (type its id into “Trip id” above; empty shows all)
Log lines
panels.description: From Loki. Each line carries trip_id, user_id and trace_id: open a line for them, and for the link to its trace.

targets.expr: {job="tripplanner"} | trip_id=~"${trip_id}.*" | json message="message" | line_format "[{{ .service }}] {{ if .message }}{{ .message }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}"
